name: Kedar
description: Arabian living at the time of the Patriarchs

points: These are the generations of Ishmael: Nebajoth the firstborn, and Kedar (that is Kedar, the Saudi Arabians today), Adbeel, Mibsam, Mishma, Dumah, Massa, Hadar, Tema, Jetur, Naphish and Kedemah. These are the sons of Ishmael, by their towns and by their castles: twelve princes according to their nations. Pay attention to that: Ishmael had twelve princes, and each had a nation. I am about to show you something concerning the Sunni and the Shia.

note.label: Armageddon: Islam and the Armies of the East

points: Woe is me, that I sojourn in Mesech, that I dwell in the tents of Kedar. My soul hath long dwelt with him that hateth peace. The Israelites have long dwelt with Esau, Edom, the daughter of Babylon, who hate peace, hate us, and hate our guts.

note.label: Psalm 120: In My Distress I Cried Unto the Lord

points: The bride says, "I am black, but comely, O ye daughters of Jerusalem," likening herself to the tents of Kedar and the curtains of Solomon.

note.label: Song of Solomon 1: The Song of Songs, Which Is Solomon's

points: The burden of Dumah, a son of Ishmael, Genesis 25:14, calling out of Seir, Petra, where Arabs live today: watchman, what of the night? The burden upon Arabia, Saudi Arabia: the travelling companies of Dedanim, sons of Keturah, Genesis 25:3, and the inhabitants of Tema, Ishmael's son, Genesis 25:15, all Arabs, as the Zondervan dictionary says all Arabs claim descent from Ishmael, brought water and bread to them that fled from the drawn sword and the bent bow, the missiles, and the grievousness of war. Within a year, according to the years of an hireling, all the glory of Kedar, Saudi Arabia, the Dubai the women want to see, shall fail, and the residue of the mighty men of Kedar shall be diminished, for the Lord God of Israel hath spoken it.

The burden upon Arabia. The burden upon Arabia. So Islam cannot be the way. Because judgment is coming for Saudi Arabia. Judgment is coming for Libya. Judgment is coming for Iran. Judgment is coming for Pakistan. Read. In the forest in Arabia shall ye lodge, O ye travelling companies of Dedanim. I can't say it. But it's talking about the Arabs. Dedanim. Thank you. Read. The inhabitants of the land of Tema. Tema. Edom. Read. Brought water to him that was thirsty. Come on. They prevented with their bread him that fled. Watch this. For they fled from the swords. Swords represent what? War. Read. From the drawn sword, and from the bent bow, and from the grievousness of war. Come on. For thus hath the Lord said unto me. What did he say? Within a year, according to the years of an hireling, and all the glory of Kedar shall fail. Kedar is Saudi Arabia. So he saw judgment on America. He saw judgment on the Arab countries. Read. And the residue of the number of archers, the mighty men of the children of Kedar, shall be diminished: for the Lord God of Israel hath spoken it.

note.label: Final Call: Message to the Black Man

points: Within a year, according to the years of a hireling, all the glory of Kedar shall fail, and the residue of the number of archers, the mighty men of the children of Kedar, shall be diminished, for the Most High God of Israel has spoken it.

note.label: Isaiah 21: The Burden of the Desert of the Sea; Babylon Is Fallen

points: Sing unto the Lord a new song and his praise from the end of the earth, ye that go down to the sea and the isles and the inhabitants thereof. Let the wilderness and the cities, the villages of Kedar, and the inhabitants of the rock lift up their voice and shout from the top of the mountains, giving glory unto the Lord.

note.label: Isaiah 42: My Servant and the Light of the Gentiles

points: Concerning Kedar and the kingdoms of Hazor, which Nebuchadnezzar shall smite: arise and spoil the men of the east; their tents, flocks, and camels are taken, and fear is on every side.
